entries.what: Grace arrives at 7:20 to beat the Vinca line and teaches her five sections in B12. In third period the Brianna-Karina fallout is visible, with Karina silent and Dulce stuck between tables.
entries.outcome: Grace notes the tension and decides the lab-pair chart may need changing.

entries.what: Prep period 4: Grace eats leftover rice and ulam in B12 with Dana and they talk over the week's labs.
entries.outcome: Agrees to share the stock of beakers for the unit labs.

entries.what: Evening at home: dinner with Corazón and Isabel, then the 9 p.m. teleserye with her mother.
entries.outcome: Quiet night, no arguments about the essay draft.

entries.what: Grace covers the Tuesday lunch lab-makeup session in B12 for students who missed labs.
entries.outcome: Three students finish makeup labs.

entries.what: After school she grades quizzes and fills in the absence tracker for the Friday form.
entries.outcome: Quizzes graded and tracker caught up.

entries.what: Ramón is on a 24-hour dispatch shift, so Grace handles dinner, dishes and Isabel's reminder about the essay draft.
entries.outcome: Isabel says she will work on it tonight.

entries.what: Grace picks up Corazón's prescriptions at the Vinca Avenue drugstore after school, then drives her to the St. Anselm clinic for the endocrinology follow-up.
entries.outcome: The appointment goes fine and the doctor adjusts the schedule slightly.

entries.what: At 10 p.m. Grace reorganizes Nanay's pills in the organizer at the kitchen table before Ramón gets home, so he won't fuss.
entries.outcome: Pill organizer is set for the week and she tells no one.

entries.what: Thursday in B12: Dana joins Grace for lunch and vents about her principal evaluation.
entries.outcome: Grace listens and shares a lab idea.

entries.what: Grace teaches the afternoon sections, then prepares the supply list for next week's atomic structure lab.
entries.outcome: Supply list drafted under budget.

entries.what: Evening at home with a short disagreement with Isabel over phone use at dinner.
entries.outcome: Isabel goes to her room; Grace lets it go.

entries.what: Patricia's office confirms the parent club approved the $650 mini-grant for Grace's lab supplies.
entries.outcome: Lab budget rises to $900 plus $650.

entries.what: Grace submits the Friday form at 3:30 using her spreadsheet template.
entries.outcome: Report submitted on time.

entries.what: Grace shops for extra goggles and chemicals list after school with the new grant in mind and drafts a thank-you note to the parent club.
entries.outcome: Order list ready for next week.

entries.what: Saturday morning she shops at Ruiz Family Market and stops at Panadería Las Hermanas for rolls and conchas.
entries.outcome: Groceries and pandesal for the week.

entries.what: Grace waters the calamansi and tomato pots and does laundry while Ramón works on the Bronco in the garage.
entries.outcome: Carburetor parts still on her shelf.

entries.what: Evening: Isabel asks about going to a friend's place with Nadia, and they settle on a 10 p.m. return.
entries.outcome: Agreement reached without a fight.

entries.what: Grace attends Tagalog Mass at Our Lady of the Marsh with Corazón.
entries.outcome: Mass done; Corazón visits friends after.

entries.what: After Mass they stop briefly at the Delgado Park harvest farmers market for stone fruit and peppers.
entries.outcome: Bought fruit and peppers for sinigang.

entries.what: Corazón cooks Sunday sinigang; afterward Grace grades at the kitchen table through the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Most of the quizzes graded.

entries.what: Evening: Grace plans the week, including the third-period seating chart rebuild due Monday.
entries.outcome: Plan set for rebuilding the chart.
